description: This file implements the front-end component for a Tic Tac Toe web application using React. It includes UI rendering, game logic, state management, and styling for the game board, status display, and controls.

methods.name: Home
methods.description: Main React component rendering the Tic Tac Toe game interface.

methods.name: calculateWinner
methods.description: Determines the winner of the current game board, returning 'X', 'O', or null.

methods.name: winnerCombo
methods.description: Returns the array of indices forming the winning combination if available.
